title: VUA packages-repo-catalog command v0.1
description: The packages repoCatalog read-face command (proposal 027 F2 freeze batch 2026-09-20; stance program converged: core rulings 58d1a0c, environment verification 3bd4f12, desktop stance 75f0dac — three-domain convergence registered batch 121). v0.1 carries exactly one method, packages.repoCatalog: the per-repository inventory of installable packages (packageId / displayName / latestVersion / versionCount / description within the library's actual field ceiling). FAMILY PARTITION is the 027 open-question-1 ruling: this is a NEW read family, not a packages-catalog increment — the frozen packages-catalog word faces deliberately exclude repo-scale projections ('NO full-catalog projection — thousands-scale caches never ride this face'), and the frozen packages-repos word face is the subscription configuration face ('the subscription face is the world — NOT the refresh-derived cache'). THIS family is the cache-inventory projection those rulings reserved for it: the world of the face is the backend collection's repository set (the predefined official/curated repositories unless ignored through their switches, plus every subscribed user repository), grouped per repository — never a cross-repository merge (the per-package cross-repo latest judgment stays the packages-catalog family's fact; the two views are declared different and are never conflated). DESIGN-CONSTRAINT shape (user ruling 4): the params carry a packageId-set batch filter key — the Recipe automation flow (requirement set -> resolvable installable facts) is the first consumer of this face; the manual browse UI is the same query's secondary presentation and issues the identical shape unfiltered. Both params keys are REQUIRED-nullable in the VUA idiom (026 A5 template precedent): null = unscoped / unfiltered; a non-null repoId scopes the answer to that one repository row (an unknown repoId answers the REUSED vua.vpm.repo_not_found — the A4 removeRepo same-fact precedent); a non-null packageIds is the batch requirement set (unique non-empty ids — an empty array is not a third state next to null, it is a shape violation). There is deliberately NO projectPath key in v0.1: the latestVersion judgment runs with no project Unity constraint (the library selector's unity filter passes all when unconstrained), so no compatible fact exists on this face — a per-version compatibility judgment without a project context would be a constant null, and a constant is not a fact (it gets no wire key; per-package version-level compatible remains the packages-catalog face's frozen project-bound fact). Read-only by design: repository enable/disable and manual refresh are write faces of the packages-ops family (proposal 027 F4) and do not exist here.

repoId.description: Repository scope: null = every repository of the collection world, grouped per repo; a non-null id scopes the answer to that one repository row (the stable row handle of the packages-repos face). An id not present in the collection world answers the REUSED vua.vpm.repo_not_found, never an invented empty-shaped success.

packageIds.description: Batch requirement-set filter (user ruling 4, Recipe first consumer): null = browse-all rows; a non-null array restricts every repo's package rows to the listed ids. Unique non-empty ids — an empty array is a shape violation, not an empty filter.
